regime: M15 and H1 EMA20/EMA50 aligned, both must be complete; no daily/ADX/DMI/exhaustion gates. Tradeable OANDA quote no older than five minutes; bid below ask.
direction: EMA20 above EMA50 on M15 and H1 LONG; both below SHORT; otherwise abstain.
signals: Momentum completed M15 body >=0.35 ATR and close in final 30% of direction, distance to EMA20 <=1.25 ATR. Pullback M15 wick crosses EMA20, direction close in final 30%, distance <=0.60 ATR. NEW future completed M15 close beyond frozen trigger required.
levels: Indicative entry executable-side OANDA quote, stop 1.25 M15 ATR, target 1.8 times initial risk; fixed for life. No retroactive level revisions.
cost_gates: Observed spread <=2.5 pips for non-JPY or 3.0 for JPY, and <=0.20 ATR; prospective net R:R before extra slippage >=1.35. Reassess quote, spread, price-chase <=0.35 ATR and net R:R on next bar after response delay.
expiry_and_management: Plan expires after 90 minutes unfilled; filled positions remain open up to 96 completed M15 bars and do not close just because entry opportunity expired.
execution: OANDA ask/bid entry and opposite exit side, actual pair-specific observation >= completed trigger, <=15 minutes detection delay, one-minute hypothetical manual response, next M15 opening, no inferred fill from price move. Stops gap adversely, same-bar entry exit extreme/stop+TP ambiguity unscored.
slippage_commission_financing: Full bid/ask spread already in base R, no additional spread charge. Separate illustrative 0.25 pip per side slippage +0.15 pip per side commission stress; financing unknown and cannot be considered verified Pepperstone P&L.
exposure: Maximum three simultaneous paper positions, two involving any currency, one open per exact pair; chronological deterministic exclusions, no broker execution.
evidence: Historical/development and forward evidence separate; pair-specific actual snapshot times only. Hourly evaluations automatically replay subsequent completed OANDA bars with source evidence hashes. Fast pipeline observations cannot be retroactively inferred as shadow detection.
benchmark: Compare with v20 champion on earliest independently scored matching pair/London-day cohorts when present. Additional reproducible no-trade benchmark 0R is disclosed as a weak opportunity-cost reference, not proof of edge.
review_floor: At least 100 independent scored pair/London-days and 20 distinct days per policy, including adverse and favourable cases; floor is eligibility only. Day-clustered cost-stressed confidence intervals and a separately reviewed out-of-sample benefit are needed before any promotion.
performance_decision: INCONCLUSIVE until sufficient forward fills and verified costs; never promote from approval counts or few wins.
existing_v20: Unchanged; separate prospectively registered shadow comparator, not a silent reset or replacement.
